REFERENCE · COMMUNICATION

Useful English

Ask, listen, check and keep talking.

Keep the conversation going. Try these phrases in class and outside class.

When you need help

A
Can you repeat that, please?

B
Yes, of course.

A
Can you speak more slowly, please?

B
Yes. No problem.

A
I’m sorry. I don’t understand.

B
Let’s look at an example.

Words and names

A
How do you spell Ana?

B
A-N-A.

A
How do you say this in English?

B
It’s a notebook.

A
What does “wallet” mean?

B
It’s a small thing for your money.

Working together

A
Are you ready?

B
Yes. Let’s start.

A
Whose turn is it?

B
It’s your turn.

A
What do you think?

B
I think this one is better.

Check the message

A
Is that right?

B
Let’s check.

A
Do you mean Tuesday?

B
Yes, Tuesday.

A
Did you say fifteen or fifty?

B
Fifteen. One-five.

One phrase to use today

Choose a phrase. Say it, then use it with a partner.

Try it in a conversation: New friends · 5 · Tickets, please! · 73
